name: Fullscreen Navbar
title: Fullscreen Navbar
description: An editorial fullscreen navbar with numbered navigation, smooth dropdowns, spring-driven link entrances, and a Dev Club spotlight panel.
summary: An image-friendly header opens into a full-screen editorial menu. The curtain slides in from the right on desktop and from above on narrow screens. Dev Club navigation, a featured component, connect links and a primary action are synchronized with scoped GSAP timelines. Customize typography content, colors, reveal timing, spring stiffness and damping.
highlights: Right-to-left desktop curtain and top-to-bottom mobile curtain
Numbered Dev Club navigation with accessible nested groups
Physically damped spring response with adjustable stiffness and damping
Featured component, connect links and primary action
Full-screen scrollable mobile layout with a persistent header
Radix dialog focus management, Escape to close and reduced-motion fallback
Profile-style moving hover highlight with spring-driven labels and arrows
anatomy: Brand header, primary action and menu trigger
Radix modal dialog and GSAP reveal curtain
Numbered navigation links and expanding submenus
Persistent close control and scrollable menu body

physics.description: A scoped reversible timeline coordinates curtain transforms, link entrances and secondary content. A damped oscillator function maps stiffness and damping to GSAP easing for link entrances and chevrons. Submenus animate measured auto height. Match-media contexts clean up animations, and ResizeObserver selects the layout from container width. A shared highlight uses quickTo setters to follow hovered or keyboard-focused links, and resize observation keeps it aligned during submenu expansion.

keyboard.description: Navigate the modal focus loop and visible links.
Open and close the menu or toggle a nested group.
Close the menu and return focus to the trigger.

accessibility.aria: Radix provides modal dialog semantics, background isolation, focus trapping and focus restoration. Each submenu has aria-expanded, aria-controls, a labeled region and an inert closed state.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Curtain, stagger and submenu animations resolve immediately when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

recommended: Editorial navigation with nested component and documentation links
Custom featured content and community destinations
bestPractices: Use a positioned full-height container when contained is enabled
Provide real destinations and concise link labels
Keep the primary action and contact link useful for your site
Choose contrasting menu, header and accent colors
Use controlled open for application-managed menu state

props.name: duration
props.description: Menu reveal duration in seconds, bounded to 0.25–1.5.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Stiffness for the damped spring response of link entrances and dropdown arrows, bounded to 80–500.

props.name: damping
props.description: Damping for the spring response, bounded to 12–50.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between link entrances, bounded to 0–0.12 seconds.

props.name: accent

props.name: hoverDropdowns
props.description: Enable desktop mouse hover to open nested groups. Click and keyboard also work.
